scope: Q7 v1.01 IPU FC1 top-control predicates, bypass and mode-1 flags export. The HDR case combines static topology evidence with bounded replay.

inputs.T: u32 at the pointer stored in the topology parameter block at +4, i.e. **(topology+4). It is independent of the returned IPU/IPS wrapper kind.
inputs.S: Pass local byte +3 (pass+0x88f). For 1x1, 0x1, 2x0 and 1x0 the operation-mode function copies FIPLIB input+1 into it.
inputs.D: FIPLIB input+0x1072, set by PrepareCalculations to (upper descriptor ID 0xf slot enable byte == 0). The top controls compare D with 1 exactly.
inputs.Q: FIPLIB input+9. In PrepareCalculations it is zero unless (processor+0x26c & 0xd1ab0) == 0xd1ab0, when it is the low byte of processor+0x26c plus 0x50, stored as a byte.
inputs.H: Return value of IsANR_or_LC_or_CC_ON 0x801775e0, computed independently of D.

helper.zero_iff: All five listed u16 fields are zero, u32[input+0x1420] == 1, and (u8[input+2] == 1 or (u8[input+0x1070] == 1 and u8[input+0xc74] == 1)). Other inputs return 1.
helper.note: For 1x1 and 0x1 Q in {0,1,4}, the helper affects FC1 bypass only when S != 0 and T != 0. The 2x0 method does not use it for these controls.

export.bypass: Local+0x24 (pass+0x8b0) -> General block+0x3f via 0x80179cac -> zero-extended word payload+0x44 via 0x80179f90. Translator reads the byte and enables FC1 iff it is zero.
export.flags: Local+0x28 (pass+0x8b4) -> FC mode-1 block+0xc (block+0xd is cleared) via 0x8017ab94 -> payload+0x12c = (block+0xc & 1) via 0x8017ad04. The FC1 setter stores this word separately at object+0x48 for the writer at 0xb60000fc.
export.limit: Enable and the FC1 control word are independent fields. The coefficient values themselves are covered by fiplib-followup.json.

fresh_hdr.route: Fresh type-0 IpuToneMapRgb submission in the previously traced HDR path with no external descriptor or state mutation.
fresh_hdr.requested_enable: SetDefaults writes 1 at processor+0x104, the ID 0xf enable byte. IpuToneMapRgb also calls PathImageProcessingEnable(path,0xf,1). PrepareCalculations inverts the byte into D, so D=0.
fresh_hdr.phase_source: PrepareCalculations initializes input+0x1738 to 1 but clears it when the ID 0x1f descriptor exists and its slot enable byte equals 1. The traced HDR path enables ID 0x1f, so the topology uses phase zero. The phase byte is held at zero in the four dedicated top-control replay cases.
fresh_hdr.conclusion: Commit mode 0 selects all four IPU passes in [0,4). The final pass index 3 is class 0x1. The 1x0 and 5x1 passes set FC1 bypass; the 1x1 and 0x1 passes clear bypass. All four mode-1 flag words are zero. These are software configuration values, with physical register writes conditional on submission and the writer conditions.

replay.scope: Concrete MIPS replay of FC1 block-control methods and payload export. Synthetic input/topology, no stubs, MMIO, scheduling or camera execution.

evidence.role: Pass-class binding through top-control vtable slot +0x24
S copied from FIPLIB input+1 to local byte +3 by operation-mode methods
Phase-zero HDR dispatch and 5x1 operation mode
D and Q input provenance, upper ID 0xf default and HDR explicit enable
1x1 topology equality, exact D==1, and helper branch
2x0 S branch and independent topology flag
0x1 Q guards/delegation and main S/D/T/IsANR branches
Pure helper input sizes and zero/one results
Independent bypass and flags output paths

trace_limitations: Extents end at the next distinct sidecar address, not a typed ELF function size.
Linear MIPS32 word scan; edges are instruction candidates, not proof of reachability.
Delay slots are included in extents. Register-indirect targets are unresolved.
A jump is recorded as a transfer, not automatically a function call.
limitations: The replay initializes unrelated topology and input fields in synthetic RAM and executes the original block-control and export routines. It does not recompute the capture topology, run the scheduler, execute MMIO or simulate pixels.

The four-pass HDR result applies to the traced fresh path and its input conditions. The top-control replay uses the resolved class, topology word and control inputs; it does not regenerate the topology.
For 0x1 Q > 6 the top-control function returns without setting the two local bytes; the example replay preserves seeded sentinels and does not assign that category a normal HDR interpretation.
